  `id` (a stable element id, the `id` argument kind `click` · `type` · `scroll` take), validated by
  `escher_driver::validate` before anything runs; it runs `Session::layout` through `Session::run` — no step, pump,
  tick or settle, no load wait, the instance unchanged — and answers ONE line: the element's `LayoutExplanation` as
  stable id strings, closed words and numbers (never a `NodeId`, page text, authored style value, colour or control
  value).

- The form is the founder's, ruled and not asked again: «Глагол `layout --id` (Recommended)» — the fifteenth verb on
  every ratified carrier (the session socket, the command line, MCP, a kept check), in the form he ratified for

- `help` describes it from the tables (`describe()`), with its result fields.

- Refusals: an id the screen does not read → `stale` / `not-found`, as `Session::layout` refuses today; a malformed or

body:
# The founder's answers of the morning of 2026-11-16

The founder answered four questions by question dialog in the overseer session on 2026-11-16; the answers were read at
05:59Z. They are his own words, not a delegate's; the overseer relays them. Three are chosen labels, verbatim; one is
text he typed himself, verbatim.

## 1. «Taffy past #1372» — reversed scroll origins for every document

> «Ратифицировать взятие (Recommended)»

The option as it was read to him: the scroll behaviour change of upstream's `0980cce5f` (with its panic fix `ebacd68bd`
and the five later Taffy bumps) is taken on his word for this take. The phase measures first, as the Taffy move did —
the build, the conflicts in `document.rs`, `writing_mode.rs` and `node.rs`, the gates, the stand — and stops if it
does not land cleanly. Passed over: measure and show first, then ratify · leave Taffy at `e90751fd`.

## 2. «Errors with the action» (v030-10) — what of a panic, an error or a handler log may cross onto an answer

He chose none of the four labels and typed his own answer, verbatim:

> «Ну мы строим хедлесс верификацию поверх блица, но верификация должна давать контекст всех ошибок а не только нашей
> части, а то толку от такой верификации которая часть вообще не покрывает»

What he was offered (the phase's `founder-forks.md`, F1): 1 closed words alone · 2 the text of every record, scrubbed
and bounded · 3 the text of the app's own records alone (the overseer's recommendation) · 4 the whole text, unscrubbed.

What his words settle, and nothing past it: the error's CONTEXT crosses — the text, not closed words alone — and for
EVERY source, the framework's and the engine's records beside the app's own. That rules out option 1 (no text) and
option 3 (the app's records alone).

The overseer's reading, not his words: of the two options left, option 2 is the one built — the message of every
record, each field passed through the sink's own scrub, each message cut at a fixed bound, a fixed count of items per
answer and the rest counted — because the route entry itself reads «scrub held», which his answer does not lift.
Option 4 (every field value, unscrubbed) is not taken on these words. He is told this reading in the overseer's report
and can correct it.

Also the overseer's reading: an error the app's OWN error boundary catches is still an error an agent verifying the
app would want. The chunk in flight reports the root boundary alone (a technical answer given before his words); the
follow-up entry measures whether every boundary can be read.

## 3. «Layout explained» (v030-11) — how an agent asks it

> «Глагол `layout --id` (Recommended)»

The option as it was read to him: the fifteenth verb, on every ratified carrier (the session socket, the command line,
MCP, a kept check), in the form he ratified for `lint`, `graph` and `actions` — one id in, one line out, stable ids,
closed words and numbers, changing nothing. A thin chunk of its own, «Layout on the carriers», which also claims
v030-11. Its stated price: `actions` gains `layout` for every node, the 12 cross-OS digests are re-read on three OSes,
five verb counts move from 14 to 15. Passed over: keep it in process and claim · keep it in process, unclaimed.

## 4. The trial worktree of the Taffy measurement, 86 G

> «Удалить дерево (Recommended)»

The option as it was read to him: the builder runs `git worktree remove --force target/tmp/trial-taffy-git` between
skills.

# Founder forks — 2026-11-17-layout-on-the-carriers (phase P4)

The founder is away tonight. On the operator's directive at this take-up (chunks/2026-11-17-layout-on-the-carriers
inputs#I2), a fork that is his is written here with its most conservative option TAKEN, and no dialog is raised. His
ruled form of the verb («Глагол `layout --id` (Recommended)», inputs#I1 item 3) is not asked again.

## F1 — the cold-agent pipe's verb list takes `layout`?

The pipe (`scripts/cold-agent.sh`) holds a closed list of fourteen verbs. It is a registered crossing: the founder
ratified it on 2026-10-06, and it carries the stand's screen to the model provider on a live run. The list gates two
things:
- `isolated` (cold-agent.sh:139–147) needs exactly the server's `mcp__escher__*` tools. Once the `mcp` role lists
  fifteen tools, a fourteen-word pipe reads `not-isolated` and a live run fails.
- An agent-written check's `tool` must be one of the listed verbs (`valid_step`, :290).

Joining `layout` widens what an agent-written check may hold and what a live run may carry to the model provider.
His item 3 named four carriers: the session socket, the command line, MCP and a kept check. It did not name this pipe.

Options, in order:
1. **(Recommended)** Join `layout` to the pipe's verb list now, as `graph` (2026-11-07-ui-graph) and `actions`
   (2026-11-08-what-can-i-do-here) each joined. No cold agent is required to use it, and no bar counts it. The pipe
   stays runnable, and no live run fires in this chunk. The bar counting it stays «Cold-agent bar»'s (cry-42wl4qtm).
2. Leave the pipe at fourteen in this chunk. «Cold-agent bar» widens it, the entry that already carries the layout
   read for its bar. Until then, a live run reads `not-isolated`. No live run is planned before that entry.

**TAKEN: option 2**, the most conservative. Nothing new crosses to the model provider, and the pipe's closed list and
its contract tests are unmoved. The plan routes the widening to «Cold-agent bar» as a row of its review card's
`## Beyond the plan`. His answer, when it comes, is appended here, snapped and cited. Option 1, if he picks it, is a
two-file change: `scripts/cold-agent.sh` and `.github/scripts/test_cold_agent.py`. It rides «Cold-agent bar», or a
revision of this plan if implement has not yet run.

holds the floor. So the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries stand. The diff is OS-sensitive only through those

  second argument. No cause, session error, exit status or node key is added (architecture ·
  contract/driver-verbs/verb-table; security-plan · decision/closed-driver-verb-schema). Proven by
  `cargo test -p escher-driver --locked --lib`.

  snapshot bounds, and never `block` (CARRY cry-aen3htqi). Proven by the unit entry and, where step 8's fixture reaches
  the path, by `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --test stand_layout` in both modes.

  explanation `Session::layout` reads, refuses an unread id `not-found` and a deleted row's id `stale`, and changes
  nothing: snapshot, focus, the next diff and the clock unchanged, delivered ticks unapplied (test-plan ·
  contract/session-layout/changes-nothing; decision/no-change-read-control-needs-pending-work). Proven by the
  `stand_layout` entry. **matrix#v030-11**

  equals the call's own answer. The Cells answer stays within 1,048,576 bytes, its measured size recorded

- (driver) The explored verbs stay `click`, `type` and `scroll`, selected by field kind (architecture ·
  contract/driver-explore/explored-verbs). Proven by the unit entry.

  call's `tool_call` holds `tool` and `ending`. `host_log` and `mcp_log` read 0 id, name or reading needles at `trace`
  under both builds (obs-plan · contract/command-span/verb; decision/no-screen-content-in-logs). Proven by the
  companions and seven_guis entries.

  snapshot and lint digests are unmoved. The final HEAD's CI run reads them green on windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64

- escher-driver (native target only): the second binary, `escher-session <verb> [arguments] --session <dir>` (`src/session_host.rs`), is the driver's command line over six served tasks — the four lean ones, Cells and the load page — and the one place a served task, the stand's boot and the timer's tick handle meet a driver `Session` — `main` installs the telemetry sink first, then hands argv, the six slugs `counter` · `flight-booker` · `timer` · `crud` · `cells` · `load` (a private `TASKS` table, from which the usage line's `apps:` and the MCP `start` tool's `enum` are written) and the stand's boot to `escher_driver::command_line`; the boot starts a session through `stand` only (Cells through `stand::boot_cells`, the load page through `stand::boot_load`) and hands the timer's session its time step (`stand::timer_step` over the tick handle, through `Session::with_time`; the other five carry none and still take `advance`, which moves their session's clock alone (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18)). `start <task> [--record <dir>]` checks its recording directory itself before it spawns, then spawns the same binary in its host role, `serve <task> --session <dir> [--record <dir>]` (passing `--record` to the host); on a select the text is the engine's typeahead, choosing the first option whose label starts with it and, on a `multiple` select, its match alone, as `type`'s help says; `press` presses its key on what holds focus (shift when asked;
